main_text.p: Gravidatio, Jobi 3.3. Hinc & in Jonathane: וּשְׁלִימוּ מַאתָן וְשׁוּבְעִין יוֹמֵי עִבּוּרֵהָאּ Et completi fuerunt ducenti & septuaginta dies conceptus ejus, Genes.25.24.
עוּבְרָא Ch. Embryo, Foetus in utero adhuc inclusus, Cant.7.2. Plur.emph. עוּבְרַיָּא Psal.68.27.
עֲכוֹרָא Ch. Transitor, viator, hospes. Plur. emphaticus לַעֲכוֹרַיָּא וּלְתַאוּבַיָּא Transientibus & redeuntibus, id est, Viatoribus, hospitibus, Genes.22.33. in Jon. Forma prava.
עֲבְרָא, עֲבַר Ch. Vectis, repagulum, pessulus. Plural. עֲבְרָיָא, עֲבְרִין.
עוּבְרְתָא, עוּבְרָא Chal. Ramus, palmus, furculus. Plural. עוּבְרָן.
תַּעֲבוּר Ch. Excandescentia, furor, indignatio, Hebr. עֲבְרָה.
עגל Pahel, Syr. Volvere, avolvere, devolvere, Matth.27.60. & 28.2. Part. foemin. ܓܠܠܐ Quod avolutus sit, Mar.16.4. Luc.24.2. Convenit cum גלל.
עגְלְתָא, וְעגְלָא & עגְלְתָא, עגְלָא Chald. Plaustrum, Currus plaustralis. Plur. עגְלָן, עגְלְתָא & עגְלָן, עגְלְתָא.
עגילא, עגיל Ch. Scutum: Item Rotundum, vel est nomen proprium loci, Jerem.31.39. Plur. עגילין Scuta.
עגְלָא עגְלא עגל Ch. & Syr. Vitulus. Plur. עגְלִין. Foemin.
עגְלְתָא, עגְלָא Vitula, Juvenca, Syriac. ܥܓܠܬܐ, ad Hebraeos 9.13.
עין־עגְלָא Ch. Oculus vituli, Nomen est lapidis pretiosi

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek-like and Syriac words are reproduced as far as legible; several vowel-pointed forms are uncertain. Lower line is partly illegible at the right edge. The catchword is uncertain and may be absent.
